title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info and paste the request there, for a deep dive.

items.headline_md: **Democrats win the House and Senate** in a midterm wave
items.summary_md: AP reports Democrats took both chambers; NBC projects at least 258 House seats and seven Senate flips (Iowa, Kansas, Maine, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, Texas).

items.headline_md: Update: **US and Iran** still far apart as **Qatar** steps up mediation
items.summary_md: A senior Iranian official told Reuters the sides remain far from a deal after limited US strikes on Qeshm Island; Tehran ties reopening Hormuz to sanctions relief.

items.headline_md: Update: **Russia** fires 365 missiles and drones at **Ukraine's** power grid
items.summary_md: Zelenskiy says the strikes knocked out power across regions a week before US-brokered talks, and the Zaporizhzhia aid-school death toll has risen to at least 33.

items.headline_md: **Trump** says US will stop about **$4B** a year in aid to **Israel** after 2026
items.summary_md: He gave no details on how, since the current aid memorandum runs through September 2028.

items.headline_md: **Ethiopia** expels six **Sudanese** diplomats
items.summary_md: Relations keep sliding as each side accuses the other of backing its enemies (the RSF and Tigray rebels).

items.headline_md: **Greenland** parliament approves defense pact with the **US and Denmark**; **Spain's** transport minister resigns
items.summary_md: The Greenland deal paves the way for a bigger US military presence; in Spain, Óscar Puente quit after a Toledo high-speed train crash killed 69.

items.headline_md: **AMD** jumps 7%+ premarket on a Q3 beat and strong outlook
items.summary_md: AMD guided Q4 sales above estimates and expects 80% revenue growth in 2027 on data-center chips.

items.headline_md: **Novo Nordisk** beats as the **Wegovy pill** tops estimates; outlook raised
items.summary_md: Q3 sales were DKK 79.2B ($11.9B) and shares rose as much as 6%; the CFO will leave at year-end.

items.headline_md: **CVS Health** beats, raises guidance and plans a split
items.summary_md: Investing.com reports CVS topped estimates and lifted guidance alongside its plan to split in two.

items.headline_md: **Uber** posts Q3 results
items.summary_md: Uber released its third-quarter 2026 results this morning.

items.headline_md: **Disney** plans thousands of job cuts, its fourth round this year
items.summary_md: AdExchanger, citing Bloomberg, says managers have a 20% reduction goal.

items.headline_md: **Ubisoft** reportedly bids for **Arkane Lyon** (Marvel's Blade) from Xbox
items.summary_md: At least three companies have made offers, and Microsoft extended the buyer search to a December deadline.

items.headline_md: Game industry cut about **11,000 jobs** through October while hiring AI-skilled staff
items.summary_md: A tally of global layoffs shows restructuring continuing as studios add AI roles.

items.headline_md: **Valve** tightens Steam submission rules as new releases pile up
items.summary_md: Digital Trends reports tougher review requirements after volume overwhelmed the process.

items.headline_md: **Astragon** closes its Hamm studio, ending the **Seafarer** team
items.summary_md: Heise says the closure hits about 30 employees.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: no public repo or release from u/Mindstormman found today. A separate GitHub repo, [nWiiURecomp](https://github.com/BlackLineInteractive/nWiiURecomp), exists with 0 stars and isn't confirmed to be his project. Reddit's RSS feeds returned nothing to my server today, so r/decomps wasn't read directly.

items.headline_md: **Tears of the Kingdom Recomp 0.3.4**: Switch game running natively on Windows, Linux and Steam Deck
items.summary_md: The static recomp by valentderah passed 4,000 GitHub stars in under a week; 0.3.4 fixes audio dropouts, amiibo crashes and Intel GPU errors (author says much of the code is AI-written).

items.headline_md: **DriveClub Recomp** (PS4) adds DLSS, Reflex and FSR 4
items.summary_md: It runs the PS4 game's x86-64 code natively with Vulkan graphics, up to 4K and unlocked frame rates; needs your own copy at patch 1.28.

items.headline_md: Recomp tracker logs **200 releases** this week, incl. **PS4Recomp 0.1.1**, **Saints Row** static recomp 0.1.0 and **Smash4PC** 0.1.2
items.summary_md: Other Nov 2–4 drops include Xenia Canary, Luigi's Mansion Recompiled 1.1.6, Konami Viper static recomp 0.13 and Metroid Prime Port 0.40.

items.headline_md: Global weekend (Oct 30–Nov 1): **Clayface** leads with **$22.8M** worldwide
items.summary_md: It's at $83M WW on a $44M budget; Laika's **Wildwood** was No. 2 globally with $12.3M ($35.8M cume).

items.headline_md: **Resident Evil** reaches **$400M** worldwide
items.summary_md: Deadline says it's passed Sinners and The Nun and is $600K from topping Backrooms as A24's biggest.

items.headline_md: **The Odyssey** hits **$1.799B** WW, Universal's biggest international cume ever
items.summary_md: Its $1.17B overseas beats Furious 7; domestic finished at $625.5M.

items.headline_md: Nov 6 openers: **The Cat in the Hat** and **Godzilla Minus Zero** both tracking **$25–35M**
items.summary_md: Box Office Theory calls the No. 1 spot a close race.

items.headline_md: **Other Mommy** passes **$107.4M** worldwide
items.summary_md: The Blumhouse horror added $8.4M globally in its fourth weekend with strong European openings.

items.headline_md: **Tencent** launches **Hy4**, adding image understanding, with open weights coming
items.summary_md: Pricing stays at about $2.70 per million output tokens; weights and system cards are due in the coming days.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** partners with **Cathedral Systems**, the firm that probed Anthropic
items.summary_md: OpenAI also raised bug-bounty rewards and said ChatGPT has 1.2 billion weekly users.

items.headline_md: **Google** makes schools that turn off its AI lose **Search** too
items.summary_md: Lina Khan said Google is making clear it will punish those who don't fall in line.

items.headline_md: **AMD**, **FuriosaAI** and **MangoBoost** form an AI infrastructure alliance
items.summary_md: They'll combine CPUs, GPUs, NPUs and DPUs, targeting a first system in 2027.

items.headline_md: **Google Play** opens its **Registered App Stores** program: $10,000 a year, US excluded
items.summary_md: From Dec 1, approved third-party stores on Android 17 QPR2+ get one-tap installs and background updates.

items.headline_md: **Apple** opens **Siri AI** to developers in the iOS 27.3 betas
items.summary_md: Apps can hook content and actions into Siri through App Intents, including multi-step requests.

items.headline_md: **Reddit** starts testing **search ads**; **Netflix** launches **AI Discover**
items.summary_md: Reddit's ads will match search context, days after it moved to login-only viewing.

items.headline_md: **Lenovo** ships a 1.6-liter desktop that runs ~35B-parameter models locally
items.summary_md: It pairs a Zhaoxin CPU with a 160 TOPS Houmo NPU, about 29 tokens/sec on Qwen3.6-35B.

items.headline_md: Futures rally on the blue wave (**4:45 AM AZ**): **Dow** +1.58%, **S&P 500** +1.16%, **Nasdaq-100** +0.96%
items.summary_md: They recovered from overnight lows; Tuesday the S&P gained 0.4% and the Dow slipped 0.4%.

items.headline_md: Movers: **AMD** +7%+, **Palantir** −2.3%; **SpaceX** and **Trump Media** lower premarket
items.summary_md: Palantir fell on worries a Democratic Congress tightens rules on data centers.

items.headline_md: **Gold** back above **$4,000**, about $4,037 (+2.5%) at **5:08 AM AZ**
items.summary_md: A weaker dollar and falling yields lifted it.

items.headline_md: **Bitcoin** V-shaped rebound to about **$78,300** (**1:37 AM AZ**)
items.summary_md: It dipped below $76,000 as results came in, then recovered as uncertainty faded.
Traders await Washington's next move on Iran.

items.headline_md: **Phoenix AZ:** sunny, high near **77°F**, low around **56°F**, **0%** precip
items.summary_md: No active alerts.

items.headline_md: **Show Low AZ:** sunny and breezy, high near **59°F**, low around **34°F**, ~**1%** precip
items.summary_md: SW winds 13–20 mph, gusts to 35 mph; no active alerts.

items.headline_md: **Snowflake AZ:** sunny and breezy, high near **65°F**, low around **33°F**, ~**1%** precip
items.summary_md: SW winds 10–21 mph, gusts to 36 mph; no active alerts.

items.headline_md: **Ballotpedia:** Democrats win U.S. House and Senate majorities
items.summary_md: A clear, race-by-race rundown of every Senate flip, the redistricting math and state legislature changes behind last night's wave.
